description: Active Amount Off Product coupon on the store and profile, flat amount off each unit of its products once the minimum quantity is met, attached to productId and, when given, also secondProductId. KB: Configuring a Promotion (Find Product, Minimum Quantity, Is Allowed With Other Coupon).

discountAmount.description: Amount or percent the promotion takes off, as the test asserts it

allProfiles.description: false when the test also checks that another profile gets NO discount; true when it must apply to every profile

store.description: Store code the webstore under test serves (ZnodePortal.StoreCode)

profile.description: Profile code the promotion must apply to: the declared user's profile, or the store's default anonymous profile for guest steps

now.description: System param: evaluation time, filled in by the profiler or resolver; tests do not set it

quantityUsed.description: Quantity the test raises the eligible line to; the minimum quantity must be reached at it but not at the starting quantity of 1

redemptionsNeeded.description: Orders the test places with the coupon (minimum 1: the coupon must have a use left to apply)

allowedWithOtherCoupons.description: Is Allowed With Other Coupon: true when the test stacks a second coupon on it; false otherwise (Znode default)

productId.description: Product the coupon discounts (Find Product); link it to the product need, e.g. @product.productId. Id as promotion_products.promotionProductId

orderMinimum.description: Optional Minimum Order Amount the coupon is created with (KB: Configuring a Promotion); left out = the collection default / any

secondProductId.description: Optional second product the coupon also discounts (Find Product lists several), e.g. @product2.productId. Id as promotion_products.promotionProductId
